title: Merge Sorted Arrays
description: Given two sorted integer arrays `nums1` and `nums2`, merge them into a single sorted array in non-decreasing order.
input_format: First line contains `m` and `n`. Second line contains `nums1`. Third line contains `nums2`.
hints: Use two pointers starting at the beginning of each array.
Compare current elements, append the smaller one, and advance that pointer.
Append remaining elements from whichever array is not exhausted.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    m, n = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    nums1 = [int(x) for x in data[2:2+m]]
    nums2 = [int(x) for x in data[2+m:2+m+n]]
    res = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < m and j < n:
        if nums1[i] <= nums2[j]: res.append(nums1[i]); i += 1
        else: res.append(nums2[j]); j += 1
    res.extend(nums1[i:]); res.extend(nums2[j:])
    print(' '.join(map(str, res)))
